BELFRY.definition: A bell tower; usually stands alone unattached to a building.

FLYER.gloss: an advertisement intended for wide distribution
FLYER.definition: An advertisement (usually printed on a page or in a leaflet) intended for wide distribution.
FLYER.example: He mailed the circular to all subscribers.

BERYL.definition: The chief source of beryllium; colored transparent varieties are valued as gems.

RELY.example: You can count on me to help you any time.

FLY.definition: Travel through the air; be airborne.

BYE.gloss: an automatic advance to the next round in a tournament without playing an opponent
BYE.definition: An automatic advance to the next round in a tournament without playing an opponent.
BYE.example: He had a bye in the first round.

FRY.example: If the children stay out on the beach for another hour, they'll be fried.

REF.gloss: the chief official who is expected to ensure fair play
REF.definition: (sports) the chief official (as in boxing or American football) who is expected to ensure fair play.
